settings.title: Settings
settings.hazard_hints_note: Level crossings, schools, danger signs from OpenStreetMap. No speed camera warnings (illegal in Switzerland)
settings.auto_park: Remember the parking spot after each trip
settings.prov_auto: Automatic: matching the map (Mapbox, otherwise OpenStreetMap)
settings.world_google: Google photorealistic (key required, lots of data)
settings.key_google_note: Google map with route and traffic, Google voice, 3D; sends location and destination to Google (USA)
settings.key_mapbox_note: Map, search, route with traffic; sends position and destination to Mapbox (USA)
settings.backup_note: Saves trips, maintenance and settings to a file, for example to move from the browser into the app. The file also contains the keys you entered.
settings.backup_invalid: This file is not a CoDriveMate backup.
settings.brand_line: Vehicle cockpit · data stays on this device
settings.keys_note: All keys stay on this device. Free data: OpenFreeMap/OpenStreetMap, OSRM, Nominatim, Overpass, swisstopo, Open-Meteo. These services receive your approximate position; the 3D view can be switched off.

scene_note.sky: sun position, haze, headlights at night
scene_note.swissBuildings: with roofs from swisstopo, switches the terrain on
scene_note.swissTrees: from swisstopo, switches the terrain on

settings.scene_privacy: The 3D view loads map sections around the position: from swisstopo (Switzerland), OpenFreeMap and Overpass, and with “Mapbox” and “Google” from these providers (USA). “Mapbox” and “Google” may cost money depending on use. Everything is stored except Google and, in the browser, Mapbox.
settings.ai_privacy: With every question the provider of the chosen model, Anthropic or OpenAI (both USA), receives: the question and the chat of this session, vehicle, live values, current street, destination and arrival. Conversation mode also sends nearby place names, the time, the state of the car (tank almost empty, engine cold, standing) and figures of the current drive (distance, duration, hard braking and acceleration); for these, Wikipedia gets the approximate location (about 100 m). Driven routes, the logbook and other keys are never sent. Speech input uses the service of the device (Apple or Google).
settings.key_openai_note: for ChatGPT; a ChatGPT subscription is not enough
settings.swiss_traffic_url_note: delivers the messages of opentransportdata.swiss; none without an address
settings.cloud_voice_note: needs the Google key with “Cloud Text-to-Speech API”; sends the spoken text to Google (USA)
settings.voice_sample: In 300 metres turn right onto Station Street.

voice_problem.refused: The service refuses the key or the voice. For Google, “Cloud Text-to-Speech API” must be switched on. Until then the device speaks.
voice_problem.quota: The quota of the voice is used up. Until then the device speaks.

settings.background_note: prompts and logbook also with a locked screen, only with OBD or an active route; needs more battery
settings.reset_pauses_note: Services with a used up quota or a refused key are tried again.
settings.openai_voice_note: needs the OpenAI key (section “AI copilot”); a ChatGPT subscription is not enough. Sends the spoken text to OpenAI (USA) and costs per prompt. If OpenAI does not read word for word, the device speaks.
settings.key_elevenlabs_note: sends the spoken text to ElevenLabs (USA); uses credits
settings.eleven_failed: The voices could not be loaded. Is the key right and may it read voices?

spoken_note.warnings: vehicle and tank; they are always shown
